mapper.sql: synced_at is null and next_attempt_at <= utc_timestamp(6) and (lease_until is null or lease_until <= utc_timestamp(6))
mapper.insert: insert into (bu_id,reply_id,version,operation,payload,updated_at,next_attempt_at) values (#{buId},#{replyId},#{version},#{operation},#{payload},utc_timestamp(6),utc_timestamp(6)) as desired on duplicate key update version=desired.version, operation=desired.operation, payload=desired.payload, updated_at=greatest(utc_timestamp(6), timestampadd(microsecond,1,.updated_at)), next_attempt_at=utc_timestamp(6), attempts=0, job_id=null, last_error=null, synced_at=null
mapper.select: select operation,synced_at is not null as synced,last_error is not null as has_error from where bu_id=#{buId} and reply_id=#{replyId} and version=#{version}
select bu_id,reply_id from where bu_id in #{buId} and order by next_attempt_at,bu_id,reply_id limit 16
mapper.update: update set lease_token=#{token},lease_until=timestampadd(second,45,utc_timestamp(6)) where bu_id=#{buId} and reply_id=#{replyId} and
mapper.select: select version,operation,payload,updated_at,attempts,job_id from where bu_id=#{buId} and reply_id=#{replyId} and lease_token=#{token}
mapper.update: update set job_id=#{jobId},attempts=#{attempts},last_error=#{error}, synced_at=case when #{complete} then utc_timestamp(6) else null end, next_attempt_at=timestampadd(second,#{delaySeconds},utc_timestamp(6)),lease_token=null,lease_until=null where bu_id=#{buId} and reply_id=#{replyId} and lease_token=#{token} and updated_at=#{updatedAt}
update set lease_token=null,lease_until=null where bu_id=#{buId} and reply_id=#{replyId} and lease_token=#{token}
